## ENTITIES - Social Actions (Generic)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/entity-social-actions

**Body Parameters:**
- `entity_type`: recipes, translations, trainings, articles...
- `entity_id`: UUID of the entity
- `action`: comments, rating, favorite, favorites
- `method`: GET, POST, DELETE (default: POST)

**Headers:**
- `X-Project-ID`: bot-appetit, torah-bot, torah-fun...

**Body (depends on action):**
- comments: `discord_user_id`, `content`, `discord_username`
- rating: `discord_user_id`, `score` (1-5)
- favorite: `discord_user_id`

**Replaces:**
- recipes-add-comment
- recipes-get-comments
- recipes-add-rating
- recipes-get-ratings
- recipes-delete-comment
